assumptions: The drawing is on screen: a figure is taken from the live picture.
limits: Writes to the notebook held in this browser.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Stores a picture the app already drew; computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Add this drawing to the lab notebook as a figure.

description: Put a drawing that is on screen into the lab notebook as a numbered figure: a chart, gel, map or any other picture a tool drew on the stage. It is appended to the entry the user has open (or to the one you name), captioned with the drawing, the tool that drew it and what that tool concludes now, and numbered where it falls, exactly as the Export panel and a chart's own menu do it. Vector drawings stay vector.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

caption.description: a caption to use instead of the generated one. Leave it out unless the user asked for wording: the generated caption names the drawing, the tool and its reading.

drawing.description: the drawing to take, by its name (a chart's title, e.g. "Melt curve"). Leave it out to take the first drawing of the tab.

entry_id.description: append to this entry instead of the open one; with neither, a new entry is started and named after the drawing.

tab.description: the stage tab or the tool surface id it shows (e.g. `qpcr-curves`). Leave it out for the tab the user is looking at.

name: add_notebook_figure

entry_id.description: the entry the figure went into

figure.description: its figure number in that entry, as the preview and every export print it
